heroes.name: Pulse Tech
heroes.pickerBlurb: Plants burn on every hit, then detonates it for burst damage.

directives.name: Flashpoint
directives.desc: Burn applied by this hero deals one tick of damage immediately.

directives.name: Sustained Ignition
directives.desc: Burn applied by this hero lasts 1 additional turn.

directives.name: Conductor
directives.desc: This hero's chain attacks jump to 1 additional enemy.

directives.name: Amplifier
directives.desc: This hero's chain hits deal 100% damage instead of 50%.

heroes.name: Strike Unit
heroes.pickerBlurb: Marks targets low, deletes them high. Pure single-target damage.

directives.name: Serrated
directives.desc: This hero's piercing attacks also breach the target.

directives.name: Momentum
directives.desc: Each kill adds 4 damage to the next damaging ability.

directives.name: Thermal Trauma
directives.desc: This hero deals +3 damage to burning enemies.

directives.name: Flash Cautery
directives.desc: This hero's 20 ability detonates the target's burn after dealing damage.

heroes.name: Spike Guard
heroes.pickerBlurb: Taunts hits onto itself, spikes attackers, and breaks enemy shields.

directives.name: Rampart
directives.desc: This hero grants 2 additional shield with shield abilities.

directives.name: Bunker Doctrine
directives.desc: When this hero shields another hero, that hero also gains 3 spike this round.

directives.name: Ironclad
directives.desc: While this hero is taunting, incoming hits deal 2 less damage.

directives.name: Counterweight
directives.desc: This hero's spike abilities grant 4 additional spike.

heroes.name: Avalanche Suit
heroes.pickerBlurb: Freezes dice to lock and repeat results. Heals the squad high.

abilities.name: Avalanche Barrage
abilities.eff: 8 damage (all enemies), freeze all enemies 1 turn

abilities.name: Absolute Zero
abilities.eff: 10 damage (all enemies), freeze all enemies 1 turn

directives.name: Deep Freeze
directives.desc: This hero's freeze abilities last 1 additional turn.

directives.name: Shatterpoint
directives.desc: This hero deals +6 damage to enemies with frozen dice.

directives.name: Field Triage
directives.desc: When this hero restores HP, grant 3 shield to the healed hero.

directives.name: Entrench
directives.desc: This hero starts each battle with 10 shield.

heroes.name: Splice Medic
heroes.pickerBlurb: Heals allies low, drains enemies mid, hits shockingly hard on 20.

evolutions.name: Combat Medic
evolutions.focus: Frontline healing and a strong revive

directives.name: Combat Sense
directives.desc: This hero's single-target attacks mark the target after hitting.

directives.name: Field Surgeon
directives.desc: Resuscitate revives its target at 100% max HP.

directives.name: Reinforced Mesh
directives.desc: While this hero is alive, shield grants to the squad gain 2 additional shield.

directives.name: Resuscitation Loop
directives.desc: Mass Revival revives each fallen hero at 50% max HP.

heroes.name: Field Engineer
heroes.pickerBlurb: Generates Protocol and shields low, then turns to squad-wide damage.

directives.name: Deep Cells
directives.desc: Increase the squad's Protocol cap by 2.

directives.name: Power Wiring
directives.desc: Bias Charge grants 2 additional Protocol.

directives.name: Silent Running
directives.desc: This hero gains cloak after using an ability that deals no damage.

directives.name: Ambush Wiring
directives.desc: This hero's attacks from cloak deal +5 damage.

heroes.name: Ghost Operative
heroes.pickerBlurb: Cloaks past big hits and strikes from stealth.

directives.name: Ghostblade
directives.desc: This hero's attacks from cloak also execute.

directives.name: Vanish
directives.desc: Once per battle, this hero gains cloak when damage leaves them alive below 50% max HP.

directives.name: Marked for Death
directives.desc: This hero's single-target attacks mark the target after hitting.

directives.name: Reaper
directives.desc: This hero's execute bonus triggers below 35% max HP instead of 25%.

heroes.name: Signal Breaker
heroes.pickerBlurb: Drags every enemy roll down and jams their strongest dice.

directives.name: Wall of Static
directives.desc: This hero's abilities that reduce all enemy rolls also jam those dice with a cap of 15.

directives.name: Feedback
directives.desc: Enemies affected by this hero's roll penalties take 2 damage each round.

directives.name: Hard Lock
directives.desc: This hero's single-target roll penalties also jam the target's die.

directives.name: Signal Theft
directives.desc: Gain 1 Protocol for each enemy affected by this hero's roll penalties.
